basic_info.description: Discover the potential at 161 Stoneridge Lane, San Francisco. This 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom condo is the perfect opportunity for those seeking a fixer-upper in the vibrant Crocker Amazon neighborhood.  With 1,068 sqft of living space, this property is a blank canvas waiting for your vision. The layout included an open living and dining area, a kitchen ready for updates, and two generously sized bedrooms, including a primary en-suite.  The property offers in-unit laundry, one in garage parking space, and in a gated community. Its location provides easy access to shopping, dining, public transportation and major highways for commuting. Whether you’re an investor or a homeowner looking for a project, this home is brimming with potential. Bring your creativity and make it your own!
